newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures rebound at close,eye payrolls.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures rebound at close,eye payrolls.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures rebound by the close of Friday's trade as players short-covered ahead of the weekend and the release of the U.S. non-farm payrolls data.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 March contract gained 125 points to end at 18,180 after finding strong support at the key technical level of 17,800.
Dealers said the underlying cash market recovered from early anxieties surrounding Nomura Securities Co Ltd's disclosure that its directors had been involved in apparently irregular deals.
"The impact from that news was not so great. Only two executives are supposed to be involved so the losses are likely to be limited," said a trader with a Japanese futures house.

He said the market was still in a downtrend despite Friday's late gains. "I would look to sell around 18,200 and place a stop above 18,300," he said, adding the March Nikkei could test the 17,800 level again next week.
The contract was not pushed lower because several players had already sold it down in recent days and chose to take profit when it opened weak, he said.
The March MSCI Taiwan index contract ended at 342.9 against its opening 338.8 on 472 lots.
